basic_info.description: Welcome to 1642 Noriega St, a delightful home in San Francisco's coveted Sunset neighborhood offering timeless charm, modern convenience, and an unbeatable location. This property features a 2 bedroom main level and a legal studio on the lower level, providing flexibility for extended family, rental income, or a private workspace.  Inside, enjoy elegant hardwood floors, a center patio that fills the home with natural light, and a formal dining room perfect for gatherings. The inviting living room with a fireplace adds warmth and character, while the breakfast room offers a cozy space to start your day.  Zoned NC-2, this home is ideally situated near excellent schools, Golden Gate Park, and vibrant restaurants and shops. Transportation is a breeze, with easy access to Muni and major routes. Just a short drive away, you'll find Safeway, Stonestown Galleria, and the bustling streets of Taraval and Irving. Step outside your front steps to restaurants and shops on Noriega. Half a block from Sunset Reservoir Park, enjoy breathtaking city views and outdoor leisure. Perfectly blending comfort, convenience, and community, 1642 Noriega St is a wonderful place to call home in one of San Francisco's most sought after neighborhoods.
